author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
description: Consumables, curatives, and field draughts for Tenebris and Lux

items.name: Sacyran Herb
items.description: A fragrant wild medicinal leaf gathered from the Dio foothills. Restores 30 Vitality (HP).

items.name: Phial of Light
items.description: A concentrated vial of luminous mineral water. Restores 25 Shield Resonance.

items.name: Dispel Herb
items.description: A bitter dried root that purges negative tactical statuses such as burning, bleeding, and stasis.

items.name: Tenebrous Draught
items.description: An invigorating bitter tonic distilled from deep-cavern moss. Restores 20 Sword Edge Resonance and clears exhaustion.

items.name: Elixir of Equilibrium
items.description: A pristine dual-phase brew of light essence and shadowy loam. Restores 50 HP, 25 Shield, and 25 Sword Edge.

items.name: Dawn Tear Salve
items.description: A sanctified resin blessed at the Church of the Sovereign. Revives a fallen ally with 50% Vitality.
